description: Set in the exclusive Melody Acres neighborhood, this fully turnkey Mediterranean estate sits on a flat, expansive, resort-caliber lot that transforms everyday living into something far more special. Designed for those who value space and privacy, this is the kind of home families wait years for, where everyday living feels like a private retreat and every gathering feels elevated. From the moment you enter, the home opens into a bright and airy main living space where soaring 14-foot vaulted ceilings with exposed beams and an abundance of natural light create an immediate sense of openness. The living room, dining area, kitchen, and wet bar all seamlessly connect, creating a central living hub that feels intentional, ideal for everyday living and effortless entertaining. Light pours in through multiple glass doors that naturally draw your attention outward, hinting at the show-stopping backyard just beyond. The layout balances connection and privacy. A guest suite with its own private bathroom is thoughtfully positioned on the western wing of the home, ideal for visitors, extended stays, or quiet separation from the main living quarters. On the eastern wing, a hallway leads to two secondary bedrooms connected by a Jack-and-Jill bathroom. At the end of the hall, the primary suite unfolds as a true retreat, featuring a walk-in closet and a beautifully appointed bathroom with dual vanities, a soaking tub set beneath natural light, and an oversized walk-in shower. Through the glass doors, you step outside, and the entire experience shifts. Surrounded by mature palms, lush landscaping, and fruit trees (including avocado, grapefruit, orange, lime), your paradise unfolds, complete with a heated pool and spa accented by a tranquil waterfall, a cabana-style lounge, built-in BBQ area, and multiple zones for entertaining, playing, or simply unwinding. The grounds extend far beyond what you expect, with a sports court set toward the rear of the property and expansive grassy areas offering endless possibilities, whether for large gatherings, recreation, or creating a true multi-generational compound. Paid-off solar panels and a gated 3-car garage, with one bay currently serving as a flexible bonus space, complete the home's thoughtful blend of functionality and privacy. This is more than a home. It's your opportunity to step into the lifestyle you've been waiting for.
